prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a side impact at intersection. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1247; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not clear whether all of the damage came from this impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Upon inspection of the vehicle following the side impact at the intersection, the driver's side door, rear quarter panel and adjacent sill show deformation consistent with the reported collision. Some of the lower rocker and wheel-well damage may or may not stem from this event, and the shop should confirm that point before final approval. The repair plan calls for panel replacement, refinishing and frame measurement, and the labor hours requested match the scope of the visible damage. Review of the invoices shows no repeated charges for the same operations. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known from the records provided.
